title: UK Government Speaks Out About GTA 6

lines.text: The UK Government just made a shocking statement about GTA 6.
lines.label: UK GOVERNMENT STATEMENT

lines.text: The UK Culture Secretary revealed Britain should be proud of the upcoming game.
lines.label: BRITAIN SHOULD BE PROUD

quote.text: Britain should be proud of GTA VI

lines.text: That is because the massive blockbuster is developed right here in the UK.
lines.label: DEVELOPED IN THE UK

lines.text: Specifically, the game is being crafted by Rockstar North.
lines.label: ROCKSTAR NORTH

lines.text: And where is this legendary studio actually located?
lines.label: STUDIO LOCATION
lines.ai_prompt: modern gaming office building in edinburgh scotland

lines.text: They are based up north in Scotland.
lines.label: BASED IN SCOTLAND

lines.text: Rockstar North has a long history of building these open worlds.
lines.label: LONG HISTORY

lines.text: They previously brought us the entire Grand Theft Auto franchise.
lines.label: CREATED GTA
lines.subject: Jason And Lucia

lines.text: Now, the UK government is highlighting their massive cultural impact.
lines.label: CULTURAL IMPACT

lines.text: Developing one of entertainment's biggest media pieces is no small feat.
lines.label: MASSIVE ENTERTAINMENT

lines.text: Fans are reacting strongly to this unexpected government praise.
lines.label: FANS REACT

lines.text: It proves just how massive the gaming industry has become globally.
lines.label: GLOBAL INDUSTRY
lines.ai_prompt: futuristic digital stock market charts and data screens

lines.text: Rockstar North continues to operate out of their Edinburgh headquarters.
lines.label: EDINBURGH HQ

lines.text: They are putting the final touches on Vice City right now.
lines.label: FINAL TOUCHES
lines.subject: Vice City

lines.text: Are you excited for Scotland's biggest gaming export yet?
lines.label: GAMING EXPORT
lines.subject: Jason Duval

description: The UK Culture Secretary states that Britain should be proud of GTA 6, developed by Rockstar North in Scotland.
